# CittaSL (CSL) - Citta ERP Solutions Limited | Enterprise Software & Regulatory Middleware

> CittaSL (CSL), also operating as Citta ERP Solutions Limited and an enterprise technology member of the CittaNuvola Group, is a specialized enterprise software, middleware, and regulatory technology firm headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. CSL architects non-intrusive electronic fiscal middleware (CittaEFS), enterprise resource planning engines (CittaMatrix), hotel property management systems (CittaHospitalityX), interactive Gantt project schedulers (CittaPlannerX), and high-throughput API mesh gateways (CittaNexus).

---

## Primary Products & Solutions

### 1. CittaEFS (Intelligent Electronic Fiscal Middleware)
- **Category:** Regulatory Fiscal Middleware & Real-Time Tax Pre-Clearance
- **Function:** Non-intrusively intercepts invoice and billing payloads from ERP systems (SAP S/4HANA, Oracle NetSuite, Odoo, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Infor, custom SQL software), validates tax rules (Nigerian VAT 7.5%, WHT, tax exemptions), cryptographically signs records (SHA-256), and transmits data to National Revenue Service (NRS) portals in sub-240ms.
- **Key Architecture:** Operates via non-intrusive database triggers and REST/gRPC webhooks without requiring ERP codebase modification or vendor lock-in.

### 2. CittaMatrix (Enterprise Multi-Ledger ERP & Transaction Router)
- **Category:** Unified Corporate Ledger, Accounting & Transaction Routing
- **Function:** Real-time multi-entity transaction routing, multi-currency general ledger, automated bank reconciliations, inventory management, and procurement workflows for corporate groups.

### 3. CittaHospitalityX (Hotel Property Management System)
- **Category:** Hospitality PMS & Guest Folio Billing
- **Function:** Multi-property reservation engine, guest folio management, mobile check-in coordination, housekeeping task automation, and point-of-sale integration for luxury hotels, resorts, and serviced apartments.

### 4. CittaPlannerX (Interactive Gantt & Resource Scheduler)
- **Category:** Enterprise Resource Planning & Critical Path Logistics
- **Function:** Interactive Gantt scheduling canvas, automated critical path recalculations, equipment workload leveling, and multi-site project tracking for heavy engineering, logistics, and construction enterprises.

### 5. CittaNexus (Enterprise API Gateway & Integration Mesh)
- **Category:** Secure Microservices Middleware & Webhook Mesh
- **Function:** Ultra-low-latency API router featuring AES-256 payload encryption, token vault management, and circuit-breaker fault tolerance.
